jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Vapi (/ˈVɑːpi/):

  • Voice AI that resolves, not transfers

  • Powering 1 billion calls for companies like Amazon Ring, Intuit, ServiceTitan, and New York Life

  • Trusted by 1 million developers building the future of voice agents

  • Backed by Peak XV, Bessemer, Kleiner Perkins, M12, Y Combinator, and more with $72M raised

  • Try talking to Vapi now!

Why We’re Hiring This Role:

  • Enterprise demand for voice automation is exploding across industries, from healthcare and financial services to retail and logistics.

  • We need an experienced seller to lead large, strategic deals and define how the world’s top companies adopt Vapi.

  • Onsite presence is critical to successful voice AI deployments. This role anchors our East Coast presence out of NYC.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • 30 days: Learn the full Vapi stack, how customers build and deploy production voice agents, and where we win. Ramp on active pipeline and meet key accounts.

  • 60 days: Lead enterprise discovery, design pilots alongside customer product and engineering leaders, and shape solution architecture with our engineering team.

  • 90 days: Own multi-stakeholder deals end-to-end, from technical validation and security review through procurement and commercial close. Feed customer insights directly into our roadmap.

  • Ongoing: Build a repeatable enterprise motion, keep a disciplined forecast, and help shape how we hire and scale the East Coast team.

 

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of enterprise SaaS or infrastructure sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota.

  • You’ve worked at a high-growth company somewhere between Series B and Series F.

  • You’ve closed multi-million dollar deals with Fortune 500 companies, navigating long cycles with technical, legal, and executive stakeholders.

  • You’re technical enough to go deep with engineering teams on APIs, integrations, and deployment.

  • You’re comfortable selling a new category and educating buyers on what’s possible.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to NYC, and happy to be onsite with customers.

  • Bonus: You’ve built your own startup.

 

Why Vapi:

  • Generational impact: Build the human interface for every business

  • Ownership culture: 70% of the company are previous founders

  • Kind team: The founders, Jordan and Nikhil, are Canadians

  • Tier-1 Investors: YC, KP seed, Bessemer Series A

 

What We Offer:

  • Real stake: We offer a competitive salary and excellent equity ownership

  • Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision plans

  • Team love: We love hanging out, and we do quarterly off-sites

  • Flexible time off: take what you need

  • More: catered meals, transportation, gym, and a $10k annual L&D budget

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Vapi (/ˈVɑːpi/):

  • Voice AI that resolves, not transfers

  • Powering 1 billion calls for companies like Amazon Ring, Intuit, ServiceTitan, and New York Life

  • Trusted by 1 million developers building the future of voice agents

  • Backed by Peak XV, Bessemer, Kleiner Perkins, M12, Y Combinator, and more with $72M raised

  • Try talking to Vapi now!

Why We’re Hiring This Role:

  • Enterprise prospects need hands-on technical guidance to go from interest to a successful pilot to production.

  • Vapi’s API has 4,200 points of configuration, so enterprises can deploy even the most complex CX use cases. Solutions Engineers bring that to life during the sales cycle.

  • Solutions Engineers are the bridge between customers, Sales, and Product. What you learn in the field shapes what we build next.

What You’ll Do:

  • 30 days: Ramp on Vapi’s architecture, build your own voice agents end-to-end, and learn how customers build with our APIs.

  • 60 days: Lead technical discovery, scope integrations with telephony, CRM, and backend systems, and prototype voice agent solutions alongside AEs.

  • 90 days: Own the technical side of strategic enterprise sales cycles and pilots end-to-end with AEs, from first demo through security review and production handoff.

  • Ongoing: Build reusable demos, reference architectures, and documentation. Bring customer feedback to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.

Who You Are:

  • 3+ years in solutions engineering, sales engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

  • You’ve worked at a high-growth company somewhere between Series B and Series F.

  • You’re a world-class educator who can explain complex systems to engineers and executives alike.

  • You’re hands-on with code. You’re comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and scripting in Python or JavaScript, and you can build a working prototype quickly.

  • Experience with telephony, contact center platforms, or LLM-based applications is a strong plus.

  • You stay calm and resourceful when a live demo or pilot goes sideways.

  • Bonus: You’ve built your own startup.

Why Vapi:

  • Generational impact: Build the human interface for every business

  • Ownership culture: 70% of the company are previous founders

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Vapi (/ˈVɑːpi/):

  • Voice AI that resolves, not transfers

  • Powering 1 billion calls for companies like Amazon Ring, Intuit, ServiceTitan, and New York Life

  • Trusted by 1 million developers building the future of voice agents

  • Backed by Peak XV, Bessemer, Kleiner Perkins, M12, Y Combinator, and more with $72M raised

  • Try talking to Vapi now!

About Vapi

Vapi builds voice AI that resolves, not transfers. Our platform powers over 1 billion calls for more than 1 million developers, and our enterprise business has grown 10x over the past year — with customers ranging from fast-moving startups to Fortune 500 companies. We recently closed a $50M Series B to keep pushing what's possible when an AI agent can actually get the job done on a phone call.

The Role

As Vapi product scales, we have specialized the product engineering team to focus on outcomes across the customer lifecycle. One key area here is agent building and model management. Our customers expect a lot of their Vapi agents, and our Agent Platform team ensures they have the latest models available and all the configuration to make those agents successful at scale. You'll drive impact through the quality of your product thinking and your ability to move fast with engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Own how customers create, configure, and manage voice agents on Vapi. These are the core building blocks of the platform.

  • Drive the integrations and tools that agents can call on, expanding what they're capable of doing on a call.

  • Run the full lifecycle of every model Vapi supports, from evaluation and onboarding through deprecation.

  • Build the process that keeps Vapi at the frontier, so the latest models get added quickly and reliably, every time.

  • Define how model performance gets measured, so every model on the platform is judged on evidence, not intuition.

  • Run experimentation and research into the latest agentic harness opportunities, translating new techniques into features that help customers get more out of the models they use.

  • Take on the sprawl of agent configuration, currently thousands of possible parameters that can be set, and figure out how to make that power feel simple.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a PM, most of it spent building and operating technical products at meaningful scale inside medium to large sized tech companies.

  • A strong technical foundation — you don't need to have shipped production code, but you can reason through system design and architecture trade-offs with engineers as a peer.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, and the range to use them: aligning engineers, briefing executives, and presenting to external clients and partners with equal credibility.

  • A track record of owning outcomes, not process — you talk about the problem you solved and the impact it had, not the framework you followed to get there.

  • Genuine customer centricity. You've built B2B or enterprise products, and you default to talking about customers, not features.

Nice to Have

  • You've managed AI model integrations across TTS, STT, or LLM providers.

  • You have direct experience in voice AI.

  • You've built developer platforms, infrastructure products, or API-first products.

  • You've developed model evaluation or benchmarking systems.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary ranging from $240,000 - 270,000, plus equity. Vapi also offers comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and the standard perks of a fast-growing SF startup (catered meals, commuter support, and a learning & development budget).
